title: Policies for Multistage Decisions
meta: NeurIPS 2025 ML×OR workshop · journal version in preparation
keywords: Policy learning Stochastic optimization Decision rules A policy may prescribe a reachable state transition from observed history while an optimization over the operational model computes the controls that realize it. Two-stage generalized decision rules provide a specific policy class and train it with target-constraint multipliers.

title: Learning Solution Maps
meta: NeurIPS 2026 · main track
keywords: Optimization proxies Sobolev training Policy distillation Optimization proxies amortize repeated solves across related problem instances. The subject compares direct prediction, repair and completion constructions, learned correction of a tractable model, and first-order supervision of solver-selected local response.

title: Differentiating Optimization Models
meta: arXiv 2025 · DiffOpt.jl
keywords: Differentiable optimization Nonlinear programming An outer criterion may depend on the solution of an embedded decision problem with a different objective. DiffOpt.jl computes the value and solution sensitivities of smooth, possibly nonconvex JuMP models with respect to their named parameters.

title: Continuation-Value Representations
meta: EPSR 2024 · PSCC 2024
keywords: Value functions Input-convex networks Stochastic optimization Cutting planes bound a future cost only if it is convex. Input-convex networks trained on single-period optimal-power-flow costs, including nonconvex AC costs, matched unrestricted networks in average accuracy on grids up to 6,468 buses; their cuts are supports of the network and carry no bound on the AC cost.

title: Learned Model Correction
meta: NeurIPS 2025 ML×OR
keywords: Differentiable optimization Decision-focused learning DC optimal power flow, the linear program used in dispatch and market clearing, remains the procedure that computes the dispatch, while a network predicts per-demand line susceptances and shunt conductances that bring its solution close to AC-OPF, trained through the linear program’s solution sensitivities.

title: Endogenous Response
meta: SEGAN 2025 · IREP 2025
keywords: Bilevel optimization Differentiable optimization When an agent’s outcome is determined by another agent’s optimization, as when a market operator clears producers’ offers, the decision problem is a Stackelberg game with that optimization as follower. Sensitivity-based and derivative-free search through AC clearing are compared, including when each fails.

title: Uncertainty and Ambiguity
meta: Open source · PortfolioOpt.jl
keywords: Distributionally robust optimization Ambiguity sets Optimizer’s curse A decision optimized against an estimated conditional law inherits its estimation error, shift, and misspecification. This subject studies ambiguity-set calibration and the point at which a statistical description must be replaced by an endogenous response model.

title: Planning and Realization Mismatch
meta: IEEE TSTE 2022 · M.Sc. thesis
keywords: Stochastic optimization Convex relaxations Hydrothermal planning values water with SDDP on convex or linear network models while the grid obeys AC power flow. Planning with five network models and operating each policy on AC shows that relaxation tightness did not order the resulting policies.
